component.name: jsBudbrainLaufwerksTest
component.summary: Measure how fast a drive writes and reads

description.p: Writes a test file to a drive, reads it back, checks every block and deletes it again. Two level meters show the current speed live, two charts record the whole run.

ul.li: Test size from 1024 MB up to 16 GB, or a fixed duration from 5 seconds to 16 minutes
Measures the drive itself, not the computer's memory
Every block is verified on reading, which helps to uncover drives with a faked capacity
Shows when a fast drive runs out of breath and the speed drops
Worst, average and best value for writing and reading
History of all runs, export as text
Never fills a drive: space for the system stays free

description.p: First release: write and read speed of any drive with live level meters and charts, by size or by time, a check of every block, a history of all tests and 47 languages.
